question: What reason did the father give his sons for wanting to be buried beside the man of God?

readings.answer: Because the message the man of God declared by the word of the Lord will certainly come true.
readings.support: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly gives the reason: “For the message he declared by the word of the Lord … will certainly come true,” which matches the key’s claim that he was certain the man of God’s message from the Lord would come true.

reason: The text directly states the reason as certainty that the man of God’s message by the word of the Lord would come true.
